conclusion.title: BatchEnsemble: An alternative approach to Efficient Ensemble and Lifelong Learning
conclusion.read_kind: Reused frozen Round13 paper conclusions/text custody; targeted revisit for evaluation batching/complete-member work question, not another full-paper read
conclusion.exact_read_scope: Retained HTML text LF427–582: Section3.1 vectorization and test input repetition; Section3.2 hardware utilization/storage; rank-one/fixed-first-task limits. This packet binds B1/B2 exact slices427–568. Prior full focused assessment remains in round13_neural_enkf_qualification_v1.
conclusion.method_implementation_takeaway: Rank-one ensemble weights equal input/output feature scaling. Test evaluation repeats each input for all members in one effective M*B batch. Speed depends on hardware utilization; sharing W does not remove complete per-member dense transforms.
conclusion.GNNM_implication: Attribute boundary BE vectorization to BatchEnsemble; batch private GNNM trajectories through common maps with a leading member dimension, preserving all four outputs. This supports an implementation extension and useful broader GNNM work, without requiring a wholly new batching primitive.
conclusion.limitations_next_decision: Existing paper timings do not qualify selected GNNM checkpoints/graphs. Keep all member work and modern competent untied/head baselines; require whole trained-checkpoint serving utility and unchanged conformal results.

conclusion.title: PyTorch Geometric native SAGE and aggregation implementation
conclusion.read_kind: Targeted primary author implementation review at actual parent-provided runtime version
conclusion.exact_read_scope: SAGEConv source66–150; MessagePassing70–117,249–329,459–603; MeanAggregation24–36; Aggregation173–189; scatter55–90,141–145; Linear121–127. Exact slicesP1–P10.
conclusion.method_implementation_takeaway: SAGE mean aggregates messages, applies biased lin_l and adds bias-free root lin_r. Default node_dim=-2 lifts/aggregates along the node axis; mean uses broadcast degree counts clamped for empty destinations. Dense maps act on last features. Ordinary COO chooses separate message/aggregation path.
conclusion.GNNM_implication: [M,N,H] preserves independent member states when native SAGE runs along N; concatenate [normalized,message] on final feature axis, because frozen SAGEModule dim=1 is only correct for its original2D tensors. Packed untied controls may reuse parameter-free mean aggregation while retaining every private dense transform.
conclusion.limitations_next_decision: Public SAGE shape examples are2D; rank3 support is derived from primary MessagePassing/aggregation/Linear source and still needs numerical qualification. Bind installed2.7.0/backend hashes; sparse/fused/custom/decomposed/explain paths are outside this adapter. GPU scatter reduction order and message-memory peaks may remove utility.

conclusion.title: PyTorch selected Linear and feature LayerNorm implementation
conclusion.read_kind: Targeted primary implementation review at selected Torch version
conclusion.method_implementation_takeaway: Linear preserves arbitrary leading axes and transforms last features. LayerNorm with normalized_shape=(H,) computes per-row H statistics and selected affine scaling in both train/eval; it does not normalize over member or node axes.
conclusion.GNNM_implication: Selected shared dense/norm operators can preserve four trajectories under leading-dimension batching. Private control norms can be packed with algebraically identical normalization/affine terms, maintaining private weights/biases.
conclusion.limitations_next_decision: Fused versus decomposed private affine LayerNorm may round differently. Evaluation dropout only; training gradients/RNG equivalence are not claimed. Require CPU float64 and full GPU/conformal gates using selected trained states.
